description: This file defines the interface for a SNMP plugin module, including function declarations for initialization, object support checking, unloading, and memory management. It primarily contains function prototypes, macro definitions, and include guards, serving as an interface rather than implementation.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP plugin with the supported version and plugin info pointer.

methods.name: COSA_Async_Init
methods.description: Performs asynchronous initialization of the SNMP plugin.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a check of the plugin's memory usage.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryUsage
methods.description: Reports the current memory usage of the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryTable
methods.description: Outputs the plugin's memory table, detail unspecified.
